text:
Elaine: Drafting a Console "health-gate" playbook for observability launch. Want concrete checks, owners, and an automated gate we can run during canary. Thoughts?

Ravi: +1. please list the checks you have in mind so we can size.

Elaine: initial checks: 1) Dashboards load & show data, 2) Trace coverage for top flows, 3) Error slice visibility (can filter by model/team), 4) Cost breakdown per-route and per-model, 5) Alerts firing on regression.

Tess: define "load & show data" pls. dashboards should render under 2.5s and panels must not be empty for last 24h.

Diego: trace coverage: instrument entry/exit spans for 5 primary routes, include customer_id and model_version tags. sampling: only trace slow (>400ms) or error flows by default.

Noah: cost breakdown - we need token-level mapping back to model_version and team_id. that requires adding labels upstream. estimate: 2 dev days + pipeline change.

Asha: for error analytics, we should ensure we can group by error_class and surface top-10 slices. Also require at least one root-cause example per major slice in the playbook.

Ravi: runbook decision: if any required check fails for >1hr during canary, auto-roll back. can we automate detection?

release-bot: scheduled: health-gate-check job created. runs at 07:00 UTC daily and on-demand.

Elaine: yes automate. propose a job that returns pass/fail JSON and posts to #release-war-room. owners get pinged if fail.

Tess: UX ask: add a minimal "Observability Quick View" in Console home for admins showing health badge + one-click jump to failing panels.

Diego: sampling corner-case: cached fast-paths are noisy if we trace them. default: no traces for cache hits unless they error or exceed 2x typical latency.

Noah: cost threshold suggestion: projected hosted cost < $30 per 1M tokens across common routes. open to adjustment per model size.

Asha: SLOs to monitor during canary: P95 latency, error rate, and median token cost. set provisional gates: P95 < 220ms, error <1.5% for top traffic, cost tolerance +15% during canary.

Ravi: owners: dashboards = Tess, traces = Diego, cost telemetry = Noah, alerts & runbooks = Ravi. ETA for tagging + job: 10/12.

Elaine: rollout plan: 10% canary on orgs using Console UI, run health-gate job every 2h for first 48h. if all green -> 50% for 24h -> GA. failing check -> rollback and hotfix window.

Tess: I'll produce two dashboard templates: "Dev Ops" (detailed traces/errors) and "Exec" (high-level cost/health).

Noah: will prepare schema change for labels: team_id, model_version, route_id. include migration notes.

Asha: add acceptance queries to the playbook, e.g.:

```
count_over_time(errors{service=\"console\",route=\"ingest\"}[24h]) > 0
```

and token_cost_per_route{route=\"render\"} reports non-null.

Ravi: add tolerance rules: if metric is within 10% of threshold, flag but don't auto-rollback. only hard fails trigger rollback.

release-bot: note: health-gate job will attach logs to the release ticket automatically.

Elaine: next steps: 1) Noah implement labels + cost job (ETA 10/12). 2) Tess dashboards + badge (ETA 10/14). 3) Diego finalize tracing checklist & sampling (ETA 10/13). 4) Ravi assemble runbook & automate gate (ETA 10/15). 5) Elaine schedule canary and invite customers (ETA 10/18).

Diego: tagging note - for Private deployments we must support KMS redaction markers in traces. make that a must for private GA.

Tess: ack. will include export/print options for exec dashboards for enterprise audits.

Noah: I'll coordinate with customers for canary data sharing consents.

Elaine: thanks all. I'll convert this into a playbook doc and link from the roadmap ticket unless objections. please react if you disagree. :thumbsup:
